title: Consent
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — conditions for valid consent under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. When processing relies on consent as lawful basis, consent must be freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous, demonstrable, and withdrawable. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 7, Article 8 (child's consent), Recitals 32, 42, 43.

consentDemonstrable.description: Whether the controller can demonstrate that the data subject consented to the processing. The burden of proof lies with the controller. Source: GDPR Art 7(1).

freelyGiven.description: Whether consent was freely given — not conditional on performance of a contract or provision of a service that does not require the consented processing. Source: GDPR Art 7(4), Recital 43.

specificPurpose.description: Whether consent is specific to one or more defined processing purposes. Blanket consent is not valid. Source: GDPR Art 6(1)(a), Recital 32.

informedConsent.description: Whether the data subject was adequately informed before giving consent, including the identity of the controller and the purposes of processing. Source: GDPR Recital 42.

unambiguousIndication.description: Whether consent was given by a clear affirmative act — not by silence, pre-ticked boxes, or inactivity. Source: GDPR Recital 32.

consentDistinguishable.description: Whether the consent request is presented distinguishably from other matters, in an intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language. Source: GDPR Art 7(2).

withdrawalMechanismAvailable.description: Whether a mechanism for withdrawing consent is available and is as easy as giving consent. Data subject must be informed of the right to withdraw before giving consent. Source: GDPR Art 7(3).

childConsentApplicable.description: Whether the processing involves information society services offered directly to a child (under 16, or lower age set by Member State but not below 13). Source: GDPR Art 8(1).

parentalConsentObtained.description: Whether parental or guardian consent was obtained when the data subject is a child. Required when childConsentApplicable is true. Source: GDPR Art 8(1).
